entries.speaker: Mark Twain
entries.quote: Truth is stranger than fiction—to some people, but I am measurably familiar with it.

entries.speaker: Mark Twain
entries.quote: Truth is stranger than fiction, but it is because Fiction is obliged to stick to possibilities; Truth isn’t.
